product_metadata.title: Bubba Classic Insulated Desk Mug, 52 oz, Tidal Wave
features: Large-capacity coffee mug means fewer trips to refill drinks
Double-walled polyurethane with foam insulation keeps drinks hot or cold for hours without sweating
Tough and durable construction features ergonomically designed handle with soft-touch grip
Boasts a classic keg design with iconic stainless steel exterior band and a conveniently integrated bottle opener at bottom of handle
description: The bubba Classic Foam-Insulated Desk Mug, 52 oz., is just as perfect for a day’s worth of hot coffee as it is for a game’s worth of cold brew. Thanks to double-walled foam insulation, either drink will stay hot or cold for hours. The dual wall also protects your hand from any external sweating when carrying an ice-cold beverage on a hot day. This 52-ounce bubba features the classic keg design and iconic stainless steel exterior band. With an extra wide base, your bubba is ready to withstand any accidental tips, protecting your precious drink at all costs. The tough and durable construction also boasts an ergonomically designed handle with soft-touch grip and an integrated bottle opener. When you feel the first hints of thirst coming on, flip the cap open for easy drinking—no need for a straw. With its extra-large capacity, you’ll take fewer refilling trips away from your lounge chair, laptop, yard work, etc. Remember to hand-wash your new mug, which is now available in an array of cool colors to keep things fun. Rest assured..
